description:
A click event attached to a [`TextComponent`].

# Context
A click event attached to a [`TextComponent`]. Sand text values preserve Minecraft's structured JSON component model, including styling and validated click or hover interactions.

# Minecraft behavior
The component serializes to the JSON text format consumed by tellraw, titles, books, dialogs, and other vanilla text fields.

# Use when
- Building player-visible text with typed styling or interactions

# Avoid when
- Passing an unvalidated JSON string when a typed text component can express the same value

# Example
```rust,ignore
use sand::text::ClickEvent;
```
A click event attached to a [`TextComponent`].
